items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: In that band, it was Leonard Gay who was in it...

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a good band. A very good band. Then...Helvey... Then after Helvey, I went back out there. I went back out to Wisconsin. In that band, it was Leonard Gay who was in it... That's him; that's his picture up there. Look, there's the Speed Webb band. He's the tenor(?) saxophone player, the one in the middle -- Leonard Gay. He just died, I understand, a couple...about a month or two ago -- after all this time. So he was a... He was a very good saxophone player. He sounded a lot like Frankie Trumbauer. He…
